cacheHint.note: cache by the JCS-canonical policy_parameters hash only; never by wall-clock or session

description: Assembles a §27.6 haEvidenceBundle from a subject's collected human_accountability_records[] (reviewers, approvers, annotations, exception rationale, timestamps) -- same algorithm as the browser verify.html HA export card (kernels/_haevidence.mjs). Set sd_jwt:true to also export it as a Selective Disclosure JWT (§13.12), signed EdDSA over a fresh ephemeral did:key (generated per call, never reused) -- subject_hash/verification_result/kernel_version/policy_version/timestamps/submission_receipt are always-disclosed; reviewers/approvers/annotations/exception_rationale/input_hashes are selectively disclosable.

input_hashes.description: sha256: hashes of the inputs the verification ran over. Default: [].

kernel_version.description: Version tag of the kernel that produced verification_result.

policy_version.description: Version tag of the policy the kernel was evaluated against.

sd_jwt.description: When true, also return an SD-JWT export of the bundle (default false).

subject_hash.description: Required. The sha256: subject hash the bundle documents.

submission_receipt.description: Populate ONLY after a real transmission -- never fabricate.

name: ha_bundle_export
title: Assemble (and optionally SD-JWT-export) a §27.6 evidence bundle
